title: Generative AI Tutor for Programming Courses
summary: AI-powered course generation platform for programming classes.

title: Crypto Exchange Market Data Stream Analyzer
summary: Real-time crypto trade pipeline from Binance through Kafka to a FastAPI analytics layer.
bullets: Implemented a real-time data streaming pipeline that ingests cryptocurrency trade data from the Binance WebSocket API using Apache Kafka, stores time-series data in Redis, and exposes a FastAPI REST API for analytics.

title: Mobile Application Development Project
summary: Android app that checks URLs, IPs, domains, and file hashes for malicious activity.
bullets: Collaborated in a team to design and build an Android application enhancing cybersecurity by assessing the safety of URLs, IPs, domains, and file hashes with a dashboard highlighting the most searched malicious URLs using Kotlin.
